blocks.content:
• IRDAI is a statutory body.
• Established in 1999.
• Based on Malhotra Committee.
• Headquarters in Hyderabad.
• Regulates life AND general insurance.

items: Do not confuse headquarters location: IRDAI is based in Hyderabad, not New Delhi.
IRDAI regulates BOTH life and general insurance sectors.
Remember that IRDAI is a statutory body formed following the Malhotra Committee recommendations.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: IRDAI is a statutory body constituted in 1999.
Its formation was based on the recommendations of the Malhotra Committee.
The headquarters of IRDAI are located in Hyderabad.
IRDAI holds regulatory authority over both life and general insurance.
